name: project-threads
description: Claude Projects-style ongoing work coordinator for Antigravity 2.0: persistent Coordinator session, isolated Git worktree or read-only background worker threads, per-project memory sync, and live Swarm-styled sidecar board with inline chat preview.
suggestedPrompts: /coord 将当前会话初始化为项目总控协调器并打开 Project Threads 面板
/coord 拆解以下任务并并发派发独立的 Git Worktree 工作线程
/coord 同步所有活跃工作线程的进度与分支提交状态
